caption: The video depicts an indoor room where a red upholstered sofa on the left has its central section engulfed in bright orange-yellow flames, while the rounded left arm stays unburned. Throughout the excerpt these flames flicker, swirl, and rise continuously, with luminous yellow tongues dominating the left-center mass. In the foreground right, a small round table draped in a light cloth holds a remote control and a potted plant with dark red flowers. The table, remote, and red-flowered plant remain physically stationary and unburned for the whole clip. On the right side of the sofa, fire activity intensifies as the segment progresses, with taller flame columns rising behind and beside the potted plant. A wood-paneled wall and a curtain edge form the dim background. The framing gradually widens, bringing a second potted plant with pale white flowers into view at the right edge. The burning continues unabated through the final frame, with no visible resolution.
